title: Trajectory-Level Speculation with Semantic Verification for Tool-Using Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.21463v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model agents solve tasks through long sequences of tool calls, and the prevailing design has a single strong model generate every step, although many steps are routine enough for a much smaller model. Existing ways of sharing this work keep the strong model as the generator: routers and collaborative agents decide which model handles each query or step, and speculative methods check a small model's drafts one step at a time, usually against the strong model's own action. We introduce SpecAgent, a collaboration protocol that turns the strong model from the author of each step into a reviewer of steps drafted by a weak model. The weak model executes read-only tool calls as it drafts, so that every step is grounded in real observations, and holds the first action that would modify the environment. The strong model then verifies the drafted segment in a single prefill pass, commits the longest prefix it judges semantically v

translated_title: 面向工具使用智能体的轨迹级推测与语义验证
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体通过长序列的工具调用解决任务，当前主流设计是由单个强模型生成每一步，尽管许多步骤对于小得多的模型而言已足够常规。现有的分工方式仍让强模型担任生成者：路由器和协作智能体决定由哪个模型处理每个查询或步骤，而推测式方法则一次一步地对照强模型自身的动作来检查小模型的草稿。我们提出SpecAgent，这是一种协作协议，它将强模型从每一步的“作者”转变为弱模型所起草步骤的“审阅者”。弱模型在起草过程中执行只读工具调用，使每一步都建立在真实观测的基础上，并暂停在第一个将修改环境的动作上。随后，强模型在单次预填充过程中验证所起草的片段，提交其判定为语义上（此处摘要原文截断）的最长前缀。
tldr: SpecAgent将强模型的角色从逐步生成者转变为弱模型草稿的审阅者，弱模型在起草时执行只读工具调用以确保每一步基于真实观测，强模型则通过单次预填充对草稿片段进行语义验证并提交最长一致前缀，从而实现高效的轨迹级推测协作。
en_tdlr: SpecAgent transforms the strong model from a step-by-step generator into a reviewer of drafts produced by a weak model, where the weak model grounds its drafting in real observations via read-only tool calls and the strong model verifies the drafted segment's semantics in a single prefill pass.
